items.title: Back to Basics: CSS @container Filtering
items.author: (Rick Strahl)
items.description: While viewport-based ` ` queries are a staple of responsive web design, they fall short in dynamic or resizable multi-pane layouts. The newish CSS `@container` at-rule solves this by allowing styles to adapt based on the size of a specific parent container rather than the entire browser window.
